ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: DS/VW/LA/SF/02. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired: Cadastral Map No.: 910191 Block No.:- 08 Sheet No.:- 01 Situation: - Village: Ponnalai j/170 DS Division:- Valikamam West, Chankanai District: Jaffna Province: Northern Lot 01 Name of the Land: Vannaththi Odai Sekidan Madathadi; Description: Garden contains a permanent building; Name of the Claimant: Muthukumarasamy

Vinasithamby of Arasady Vadailiyadaippu; Extent: 0.2023 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Valikamam West, Chankanai DS office on the day 16th day of December 2024 at 10.00 a.m and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 02nd day of December 2024, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. All deeds and documents in support of claim should be produced before me at the inquiry.
Mඋඌ. Kൺඏංඍඁൺ Uඍඁൺඒൺ඄ඎආൺඋ, Divisional Secretary, Valikamam West, Chankanai. Divisional Secretariat, Valikamam West, Chankanai. 26th August 2024 EOG 08 - 0345
